rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act – Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources
rules.requirement: A landlord or foreclosing owner ending a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy, including by eviction or lease non-renewal, must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources at the same time as the Notice to Quit. The landlord must also send a copy of the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal, with a Certificate of Compliance/Service, to the City's Office of Housing Stability.
rules.key_value: Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources must accompany the Notice to Quit or non-renewal notice
rules.citation: Housing Stability Notification Act, City of Boston Ordinances Sec. 10-11.7
rules.quoted_span:
The Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources must be delivered at the same time as the Notice to
Quit.
rules.coverage_text: The Ordinance applies to all landlords/foreclosing owners intending to end a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of a unit in the City of Boston.
rules.exemptions: Residences in any hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility; and residences in a non-profit facility whose primary purpose is providing short-term treatment, assistance or therapy for alcohol, drug, or other substance abuse. The requirements may not be waived.
rules.penalty: First offense: warning; second and subsequent offenses: $300 per day (enforced by Inspectional Services Department). A violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.interaction: This is a local notice requirement layered onto the eviction process. A violation does not halt the eviction.
